# 🔍 Pull Request Review

## Scope
- [ ] Change matches the stated issue.
- [ ] Diff is focused and understandable.
- [ ] No unrelated or generated files included.

## Correctness
- [ ] Input units and validation are correct.
- [ ] Calculation dimensions and annualization are explicit.
- [ ] Factor provenance is complete where applicable.
- [ ] Independent examples support changed results.

## Quality
- [ ] Tests and manual checks are adequate.
- [ ] Error handling is understandable.
- [ ] Accessibility is reviewed for UI changes.
- [ ] No secrets or private data are committed.

## Documentation
- [ ] README and relevant guides updated.
- [ ] Changelog and known issues updated.
- [ ] Diagrams and templates remain accurate.

## Decision
- [ ] Approve
- [ ] Request changes
- [ ] Comment
